findings.ac: AC2: demoable end-to-end - watcher flags gemini-3.5-flash silent reroute and gemini-3.1-flash-lite shutdown
findings.text: runWatcher only classifies models from MODEL_GRADES (gemini-3.5-flash-lite, 3.6-flash, 3.8-flash), none of which is gemini-3.5-flash or gemini-3.1-flash-lite, so the real watcher run never flags either event; the tests prove these events only by calling classifyModelStatus directly with hard-coded names, and no CLI/runWatcher/generateMarkdownAdvisory test asserts a SILENT REROUTE or SHUTDOWN ANNOUNCED row appears in the report.

findings.ac: AC4 Stress: network failure fails safely with non-zero exit code and error log
findings.text: No test exercises fetchDeprecationsHtml/runWatcher on network failure, timeout (15s abort) or non-OK HTTP status; the only failure test (corrupt fixture) uses a bare toThrow() inside execFileSync and asserts neither exit status 1 nor the '[FATAL] Model Deprecation Watcher failed' stderr text, despite its title claiming both.

findings.ac: AC4 Stress: failures do not corrupt existing reports
findings.text: Code parses before writing and uses plain fs.writeFileSync (non-atomic), but no test pre-seeds a report in docs/research/model-lifecycle or --out and asserts it is untouched after a failing run; the corrupt-fixture test runs with --dry-run, so the non-dry-run write path is never covered.

findings.ac: AC3 Time-to-Value: report written under docs/research/model-lifecycle/ with swap/benchmark recommendations
findings.text: The non-dry-run branch of runWatcher (default path docs/research/model-lifecycle/YYYY-MM-model-deprecation-report.md, --out override) has no test; the report test checks only frontmatter, header and grade names, and never asserts that '[SIMPLE SWAP]' / '[RE-BENCHMARK]' action items or the 'healthy' text appear in Recommended Actions.

findings.ac: AC1 Verification: --dry-run generates a validated report
findings.text: Dry-run is only tested with --fixture; the default live-fetch path (sanity floor 15) is unverified, and 'validated' is checked only by substring matches on the markdown (no OKF frontmatter/lint check); the '--check exits 0' test just asserts the return value is defined.

findings.ac: Logic layer: ACCESS RESTRICTED status and token pricing deltas
findings.text: The ACCESS RESTRICTED branch (unlisted gemini-1.*/gemini-2.0* models) has no test, and 'Calculate token pricing deltas where published' from The Path is not implemented in model_deprecation_watch.js (no pricing parsing or report column) and not covered by any test.
